description_en: Queries a user in the current tenant by account ID and returns the account information and associated tenant roles
description_zh: 按账号 ID 查询当前租户中的用户，返回账号信息和已关联的租户角色
name: GetTenantUser

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user account in the MaxCompute tenant
parameters.help_zh: MaxCompute 租户下的用户账号 ID
parameters.name: account_id

data.description_en: The business data of the tenant user
data.description_zh: 查询租户用户的业务数据

accountId.description_en: The ID of the user account in the MaxCompute tenant
accountId.description_zh: MaxCompute 租户下的用户账号 ID

accountName.description_en: The account name of the tenant user

accountType.description_en: The account type of the tenant user. A value of sub indicates a RAM user
accountType.description_zh: 租户用户的账号类型。sub 表示 RAM 子账号

displayName.description_en: The display name of the tenant user

roles.description_en: The list of role names associated with the tenant user
roles.description_zh: 租户用户已关联的角色名称列表

items.description_en: The name of the associated tenant role
items.description_zh: 已关联的租户角色名称

tenantId.description_en: The ID of the MaxCompute tenant to which the user belongs
tenantId.description_zh: 用户所属的 MaxCompute 租户 ID

errorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
errorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

errorMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
errorMsg.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息

httpCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request
httpCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the API request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的唯一标识，可用于排查调用问题
